name: sfms
description: Field sales force management: GPS attendance, live tracking, sales targets and catalogue — Flutter app, React portal, NestJS + PostGIS.

scripts.build:design: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:i18n && node tools/sync-mobile-assets.mjs
scripts.dev:portal: npm run build:design && npm run dev -w @sfms/portal
scripts.check: npm run build:design && npm run typecheck -w @sfms/portal && npm run build -w @sfms/portal
scripts.screenshots:mobile: cd apps/mobile && flutter test --update-goldens test/design_system_golden_test.dart && cd ../.. && python3 tools/compose_mobile_shots.py
scripts.db:create: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@18/bin:$PATH createdb sfms_dev 2>/dev/null; PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@18/bin:$PATH createdb sfms_test 2>/dev/null; echo databases ready
